title: RAG document retrieval

metrics.reason: informational alongside the gated top3/clean_top3 — the design table (§4.3) floors only top-3 and clean-top-3 for this instrument; top1 is the harness's own extra breakdown, reported for trend visibility

retrieval latency has no committed SLO bar of its own yet (unlike sage-latency's cloud-chat bar from config/sage-slo.json) — reported so a regression is visible before a bar is set, per the owner-decision default to measure before floor-setting

notes: Wraps scripts/sage-rag-harness.mjs UNMODIFIED (spawned via `npx tsx ... --out=<tmp>`), run over BOTH config/sage-rag-eval.json (29 cases, 20 with expectations) and config/sage-rag-top-questions.json (40 cases, all with expectations) — the 29+40 the design table names — and aggregates the expectation-bearing cases from both (60 total). requires=prod-readonly, NOT postgres: investigated every seeding path for the hermetic CI Postgres and none reaches a working embedded corpus from empty — `npm run db:seed-documents` reads docs-upload/_inventory.txt, which does not exist in this checkout (only generated by the (undiscovered/manual) upload-to-supabase flow); `npm run sage:rag:backfill` (the only embedding step) needs a live GEMINI_API_KEY plus network egress, which the standard `gate`/hermetic-postgres CI job does not have; and `catalog:sync --apply` only re-notes ProgramDocument rows that ALREADY exist, it does not create them. The existing sage-evals.yml `catalog-drift` job independently documents the same gap in its own comment ('no such secret exists in this repo today'). Set BENCH_PROD_READONLY_URL to a read-only prod replica connection string to run this for real; until then it reports skipped, per the design's owner-decision default #7.
